name: system_facts
label: this machine: kernel, disks, memory, packages, updates, battery, date
description: Facts about this Linux machine (Arch, Hyprland), read from its own commands. Every action runs freely and returns the command's text output. pending_updates: exit 2 means no updates are pending, which is not an error. service_active: exit 3 means the unit is inactive.

disks.description: mounted filesystems with size, used, free

uptime.description: how long the machine has been up and its load

memory.description: RAM and swap: total, used, free, available

name.description: one package name; omit for every installed package

packages.description: installed package versions (pacman -Q); exit 1 = not installed

unit.description: a systemd unit name, e.g. bluetooth.service

service_active.description: whether a systemd unit is active (exit 3 = inactive)

pending_updates.description: the pacman updates waiting to be installed, one per line (exit 2 means no updates are pending - that is not an error)

volume.description: the default audio sink's volume (0.00-1.00) and whether it is muted

media.description: whether a media player is Playing, Paused or Stopped

date.description: the current date and time on this machine
